name: freeride
description: Your AI tools start every session knowing your project, and keep it up to date as they work.

interface.longDescription: FreeRide keeps each project's features, ideas, decisions, docs and work history in one place your coding agents keep current, and shows it to you in a dashboard. The same project follows you across Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and ChatGPT.
